description: Ministry of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms - Code of Criminal Procedure (Special Provisions) Act, No. 2 of 2013, Notification under Subsection (5) of Section 7
reasoning: This gazette notification pertains to the extension of the Code of Criminal Procedure (Special Provisions) Act, No. 2 of 2013, which is a legal/regulatory matter. It involves a statutory instrument and a parliamentary approval process for extending the operation of an existing law, falling squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a Minister and a Ministry, it does not focus on government personnel changes or structural reorganization, but rather on the regulatory framework of criminal procedure.
